town.text: Emberwick has seen hard winters before. We'll see this one through, too.
town.direction: warm, a little hoarse; the speech voice

town.text: Good to see you back. Truly. The square's been quieter than I'd like.
The council wants numbers and hope. I can only manage one at a time.
Mind the frost by the well. That's new. That was never there before.
Not now. Please. Whatever it is, not here, not in the square.
Speeches, speeches. I've given so many I dream in them.
If anyone asks, things are well in hand. Are they? No. Don't answer that.
